nom: IT Cosmetics Confidence in a Cleanser Gentle Face Wash

avis.texte: Love this cleanser. Love the light scent and gently cleanses my face without irritation

I really liked this face wash! It does not strip your skin, but leaves it fresh. Also, usually I don't like scented cosmetics, but this face wash has such a subtle and nice smell. I wish it could be cheaper.
This is the best cleanser on the market hands down. It leaves your skin squeaky clean. I wouldnt survive the dry desert winters without it.

I stumbled across a free sample size bottle of this that i threw in my skin care bag, one day and forgot about. Let me you, WOWWW!! I was pleasantly surprised to learn that this cleanser works great for my skin, which is combination/sensitive and acne prone. I always double cleanse with an oil before a gel or cream cleanser so I can't really speak on the make up removal aspect. However, this cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean without stripping it. It works exactly how it says. It's a cleanser and a serum in one. This is everything I've been looking for and I don't ever consider myself needing anything else again. I've heard that glycerin cleansers work well for sensitive/dry skin and it's my first glycerin type cleanser, and I think that was the secret all along!! I love how soft yet clean my face feels after using this. I love that. It's also vegan alcohol, free soap, free, and non-comedogenic. For such a long time, I thought that I needed harsh cleansers to take all my makeup off and ensure I wouldn't break out because I am acne prone and while I wasn't breaking out anymore, my skin barrier was stripped, raw, red and irritated. I was exfoliating way too much because the cleanser I used to use had exfoliating beads and I was using that every day, sometimes twice a day. My poor skin!!! 2026 is gonna be to beautiful skin for me and I'm excited!!! 🥂✨ BUY THE CLEANSER!!

I've gotten back into a self-care routine, and this is the cleanser I chose to experiment with. I love the scent (a little citrus-y) and I love how my skin feels afterwards: clean, clear, and fresh. Highly recommend!
Love the thorough way this product cleans the face. Leaves the skin refreshed and smooth!
I will definitely buy this product again. I have sensitive skin and I can use this daily without any side effects. It cleans my face and pairs well with confidence in a cream.
My favorite cleanser! Smells nice and leaves your skin feeling clean without drying it out.
I loved the refreshing foaming action and rinsed cleaned, leaving a very clean feeling! Would recommend especially if you enjoy a foamy action.

I impulse bought the trial set and so glad I did! The cleanser is the best I've ever used on my 46yo skin. My skin feels clean but not dried out or tight. It works well to remove makeup, with the caveat that I typically do fairly light makeup (tinted moisturizer, concealer, eyeshadow, and mascara). The only downside is the weird semi-citrus scent. Luckily it's not too strong and dissipates quickly.

avis.titre: Not for sensitive skin, will break you out!
avis.texte: I'm not sure how this cleanser can be marketed as "sensitive" at all. The fragrance is so over powering and it left my face feeling so dry and tight even after using face lotion. This was the only new product I added to my routine and within two days my face and neck were covered in tiny painful whiteheads that took awhile to fully go away. Do not use this product.
Great job of cleansing snd removing makeup but dried out my skin. Will be returning.
I love this wash. It's gentle, moisturizing without causing added oiliness, takes off makeup (even mascara), and is gentle enough for sensitive skin!

This has given me the most horrible itchy flaking eczema I have ever had on my face/specifically around my nose. It is not fragrance free like I have read in some reviews(smells like a dreamsicle which is nice albeit strong) I have used other cleansers with some fragrance and have never had this issue. A friend had the same issue with this product and neither of us have what I would consider to be traditional sensitive skin. This was the only new addition to my skincare routine and I do not wear makeup/no change in detergents or other factors to cause a flare up in my skin, and I am still struggling to get the eczema under control and stop spreading.

I love how this doesnt strip skin. unfortunately I always feel I need to wash a second time to get all the makeup off my face. it may just be the moisturizing properties making it feel I still have product on my face, but I like to be sure.

Surprisingly enough I was reading some of the reviews and a couple of women with sensitive skin had a reaction with this cleanser. I have super sensitive skin and decided to try this cleanser and my skin did not react to this product. First of all I lather it with little water and it bubbles and then massages and rinses. This is the only It product that I used! Clarin's is my skincare that I use for almost 20 years. Skincare is not one size fits all and you have to be careful to find the right match for your skin.

I have extremely sensitive, dry, irritated skin. This cleanser is perfect for everyday use. It doesn't smell amazing and it's a bit pricey, but it makes my skin feel incredible and clean. Well worth the money. I will continue to purchase it.

It will give your confidence a bug boost! Your fave feels smooth and soft afterwards.. and just a little cleans a whole lot- makeup, oils, dry areas, whatever's not supoosed to be there. You cant go wrong with this cleanser. I swear by it.

I have been using this cleanser for about 3 years. I have only bought about 3 of them! A little really does go a long way. I love that this is really gentle on my eyes and completely removes my waterproof eyeliner and eye makeup. Its fantastic!

my mom originally got this cleanser in a set, and i tried it & loved it. a little goes a long way… it leaves my face feeling so smooth and i swear it gets rid of my redness. i would definitely recommend this to anyone wuo struggles with dryness and/or redness!

my mom originally got this cleanser in a set, and i tried it & loved it. a little goes a long way… it leaves my face feeling so smooth and i swear it gets rid of my redness. i would definitely recommend this to anyone wuo struggles with dryness and/or redness!

avis.titre: Will keep using as long as they make it!

I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This is supposed to be safe for sensitive skin; however, I had a reaction to this. I could feel tingling while I was using it, then when I looked in the mirror, my cheeks were a dark, angry red color.

It was not hydrating which is what I was looking for. My face didn't look fresh and hydrated, it had a dull look plus the moisturizer itched my face, and had slight stinging. It didn't work for me but it may for others.
This is part of my morning routine. Love the way my face feels. It last along time.
